correctness.rationale: From the source-defined set functional, beta(A)=number of included terminal edges+(2-d)1_(all center edges included). For C consisting of all d hub edges, beta(C)=2-r<0. Omitting a center edge gives beta(A)>=0, while a strict superset with k additional edges and ell extra terminal edges has d beta(A)-(d+k)(2-r)=d ell+k(r-2)>0. Hence C uniquely minimizes beta/|A|. The supported Einstein star equations for reciprocal-degree q_i give q_long=(r-2)/(d(d-2)), q_short=(d+r-2)/(d(d-2)); inversion and normalization yield the asserted weights, checked independently for 136 parameter pairs and exhaustive subsets of three example spiders. General convergence invokes the Bai–Hua supported-Einstein criterion as stated in the source package; the source preprint full text was inaccessible in this run, so its exact hypotheses remain an explicit verification risk.
